purpose: Teach: 横目/廻り/突きつけ/交わす/悟っ/総て/浅く/喜ばしい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが横目でこちらを見てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching us with that sidelong look.
lines.style: Dry, observant tone. A small smile in the voice — noticing something she finds wryly amusing. Matter-of-fact delivery, like she's sharing a small confidence with her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お家の廻りを散歩したよ
lines.en: Mom, I took a walk around the house today.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. A child eager to report something small he did. Slight lift in pitch on the main word. Direct eye-contact tone — wanting her to know he did something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニュースを突きつけて怒ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was pushing that news at us, wasn't he — looking angry about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly weighted tone. Not critical — more observing something she's noticed quietly. Steady pace. The voice of someone reflecting on family dynamics she's seen before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと挨拶を交わすのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like when I get to greet Grandpa — when we say hello to each other.
lines.style: Gentle enthusiasm. Quiet certainty in his voice — not showing off, just stating something true. Soft on the word 'greet.' A child expressing something real he's noticed about himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがこの世の真理を悟ってらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather — he's grasped something true about the world, hasn't he.
lines.style: Reflective, warm. A mother noticing her son's perception of his grandfather. Slow, deliberate pace. Slight trailing lift at the end — like she's affirming something she's seen too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの言葉を総て覚えてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I remember everything Grandpa says — all of it.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. A child stating something he knows to be true about himself. No boasting — just certainty. Firm on 'remember,' soft fadeout after.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、傷は浅くて済んで良かったわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm glad the wound was shallow — that it wasn't worse.
lines.style: Soft, tender relief. A mother who has been worried and is now letting that worry ease. Gentle breath on the opening. Warm, protective tone underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの合格、喜ばしいニュースだったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa passing — that was such joyful news for everyone.
lines.style: Bright, earnest happiness. A child expressing genuine joy about good news. Warm lift on 'Grandpa passing.' Eager to share in the family's happiness.
